scope: Joint TOP64/BOT64 retrieval polarity from verified PerLTQA B3B per-QA outputs; no representation rebuild or rescoring.
interpretation: Per-query P64 association is weak and almost identical in magnitude to LME (~0.109 vs ~0.108). The signal strengthens after aggregation to the character/archive level (rho ~0.319; 29/30 same sign) and all four section means share the sign of their SIGN-minus-float mean. This supports a regime-level marker interpretation rather than an individual-query predictor. Profile is the only section with a moderate within-section association; events, despite driving the reversal, has weak within-section rho.
epistemic_note: PerLTQA outcome was observed before E1. Sections and characters are descriptive aggregation units, not independent confirmatory benchmarks.
